title: Colimits of sheaves of modules and the forgetful functor to abelian sheaves
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site on which every presheaf of abelian groups has a sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] (e.g. the small etale site of a scheme), let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of rings on $\mathcal C$, let $\Mod(\mathcal O)$ be the abelian category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $\Ab(\mathcal C)$ the category of sheaves of abelian groups on $\mathcal C$, and let $\mathrm{forget}:\Mod(\mathcal O)\to\Ab(\mathcal C)$ be the functor forgetting the $\mathcal O$-module structure. Then: (1) $\mathrm{forget}$ is faithful and exact: it preserves kernels and cokernels (kernels are sectionwise, cokernels are the sheafified sectionwise cokernels in both categories); (2) every diagram $\mathcal I\to\Mod(\mathcal O)$, $i\mapsto\mathcal F_i$, indexed by a small category $\mathcal I$, has a colimit, namely the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the sectionwise colimit $V\mapsto\colim_i\mathcal F_i(V)$ with its evident $\mathcal O$-module structure, and every such diagram has a limit, computed sectionwise; (3) $\mathrm{forget}$ commutes with all small colimits and limits: the underlying abelian sheaf of $\colim_i\mathcal F_i$ (resp. $\lim_i\mathcal F_i$) is the colimit (resp. limit) of the underlying abelian sheaves in $\Ab(\mathcal C)$.

proof.text: Use Mathlib SheafOfModules.hasLimitsOfSize and evaluationPreservesLimitsOfShape for sectionwise limits. The composite toSheaf followed by sheafToPresheaf is definitionally forget followed by toPresheaf and preserves limits. Since sheafToPresheaf reflects limits, toSheaf preserves limits of each small shape. Mathlib also supplies faithfulness and preservation of finite limits.

proof.text: For F, take the explicit sectionwise presheaf colimit cocone c. Let L be module sheafification and adj its adjunction. The inverse counit gives a diagram isomorphism e : F ≅ (F ⋙ forget R) ⋙ L. Precompose the cocone L.mapCocone c with e.hom. The left adjoint L preserves c as a colimit; IsColimit.precomposeHomEquiv transports that property to the desired cocone. Its vertex is definitionally L.obj c.pt, so choose Iso.refl for the vertex isomorphism.

proof.text: The right triangle identity identifies the underlying presheaf map of the inverse counit at F.obj i with adj.unit.app (forget(F.obj i)): cancel the invertible counit and compare its inverse identity with the triangle identity. Unit naturality moves this unit past L.map (c.ι.app i). Applying toPresheaf and the lemma toPresheaf_map_sheafificationAdjunction_unit_app gives precisely c.ι.app i followed by toSheafify, the required formula.
